title: Pakistan at the first R4+E3 talks in Istanbul
credits: Photos: Cengiz Özarpat, Popup Agency / Unsplash · Map: Natural Earth
lines: A new diplomatic group is meeting for the first time, and Pakistan is at the table.
It is called R4. It brings together Pakistan, Türkiye, Saudi Arabia and Egypt.
In Istanbul, the R4 foreign ministers are also meeting the E3: Britain, France and Germany.
Pakistan's Foreign Office says it is the first meeting of these seven countries in this format.
Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar is representing Pakistan, at the invitation of Türkiye's foreign minister, Hakan Fidan.
According to Turkish media, the agenda includes the Strait of Hormuz, Yemen, the Palestinian issue, and efforts to end the war in Ukraine.
Shipping through the Strait of Hormuz has been at the centre of the crisis since the US and Israel went to war with Iran in February.
Saudi Arabia is also facing Houthi drone and missile attacks from Yemen.
Türkiye is expected to argue that regional security cannot rest on military means alone, and that key sea routes must stay open.
Pakistan has been a mediator between the United States and Iran since the conflict began.
Its Foreign Office says this meeting reflects Pakistan's commitment to constructive diplomacy and the peaceful resolution of disputes.
